beats.text: Is flirting cheating? Fewer than half of Americans say yes.
Two thousand adults rated what counts as cheating in a marriage.
Bottom means nobody calls it cheating. Top means everybody does.
A secret emotional bond: seventy-six percent say cheating.
Flirting: forty-two. Following an ex online: thirty-two. Secret porn: thirty.
So if you and your partner draw the line in different places, that's normal.

sources: iFidelity Survey (YouGov, late 2019, N = 2,000 US adults; Wheatley Institution at BYU, National Marriage Project, BYU School of Family Life), reported by the Institute for Family Studies ('What Counts as Cheating in Marriage? Emotional Infidelity in a National Sample') – share who say a married person doing this is infidelity: secret emotional relationship in real life 76 %, online 72 %, flirting 42 %, following an old girlfriend/boyfriend online 32 %, using pornography without the spouse's knowledge/consent 30 %.
